parsed.explanation: No trans-specific criminal offence, facility ban, border rule, police targeting or custody rule is documented, and same-sex conduct has not been criminalised since 1791. Against that, the only current climate evidence is dated 2018-2019 and reports hostile attitudes toward visibly gender-nonconforming people, high general discrimination, no anti-discrimination or hate-crime remedy, and a judiciary not functioning as protection. A 2019 advocacy-leader death is unresolved and a 2010 camp-harassment episode is stale, so neither proves a current pattern. Thin-data extrapolation from documented hostility plus absent recourse, without documented acceptance or protections, places this in Elevated Risk: consequences if outed are unremedied social hostility and service denial, but no documented tier-1 universal exposure or organised targeting.

entry_documents.protection: Same-sex conduct not criminalised since 1791, but no documented acceptance of foreign gender markers.
entry_documents.interaction: No documented border or document rule to interact with other exposures.

federal_state_facilities.exposure: No facility or bathroom restriction documented; general hostile climate toward visible LGBTI people reported in 2018.
federal_state_facilities.interaction: Hostile social climate could affect facility use, but no rule documented.

care_services.exposure: 2010 displacement-camp harassment of transgender people and reported denial of emergency housing/healthcare to gay/bisexual men in that disaster context; no later evidence.
care_services.protection: Constitutional health guarantees extend to citizens, so visitor cannot invoke them; no visitor protection documented.
care_services.interaction: Citizen-only guarantees leave visitor care dependent on undocumented practice.

threat_framing_law_enforcement.exposure: 2017 bills, status unverified after November 2017, would have penalised advocacy and allowed good-conduct denial; no trans-specific law or police targeting documented.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.protection: No criminalisation of same-sex conduct since 1791.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.interaction: Pending bills are resident/advocacy-facing and not documented as enforced against visitors.

minors_guardians.exposure: Good-conduct certificate denial risk documented for residents/students; no visitor-minor rule documented.
minors_guardians.interaction: Resident education/employment certificate exposure does not demonstrate a traveller-family rule.

street_violence_police_response.exposure: 2018 report: hostile attitudes toward visible LGBTI people, particularly capital; 2019 death of LGBTQ organisation president, cause unresolved; no trans-specific rate or pattern documented.
street_violence_police_response.protection: No hate-crime enhancement; judiciary does not function in practice as protection avenue.
street_violence_police_response.interaction: Hostility plus no aggravated-penalty or functioning remedy increases consequence if outed.

remedies_unknowns.exposure: No statutory anti-discrimination remedy for gender identity documented.
remedies_unknowns.interaction: Absence of recourse applies across services and violence responses in the record.

anchor_checks.comparison: Higher than 0.35: no documented birth-sex facility rule, police extortion, custody placement or unremedied universal exposure, and no criminalisation. The tier-1/tier-2 exposures defining 0.35 are absent from this record.

Lower than 0.55: 0.55 has documented repeated visitor harms with some mediators, readmissions, refunds and a prosecuted assault. Here no working remedy, acceptance, or visitor-specific protection is documented, only dated hostility.

Well below 0.75: 0.75 requires lawful expression, accepted documents, community respect, identity-based facilities and enforced compensation. This dossier documents hostile attitudes, no anti-discrimination protection and non-functioning judiciary instead.

parsed.synthesis: Combined regime is formally non-criminalising but practically unprotected: long decriminalisation of same-sex conduct does not offset documented hostility to visible gender diversity and an explicitly non-functioning protection avenue. Traveler-facing universal restrictions, border screening, custody placement and police targeting are not documented, so severity is not driven to the 0.35 tier; equally, there is no documented acceptance, facility inclusion or working remedy to support 0.55 or above. Dated 2018-2019 evidence and a single unresolved 2019 death limit certainty, resolved downward because thin-data silence is not safety.
